mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN}, PantClass{NN}, GloveClass{NN}, BootClass{NN}. The numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes, so Class01 is the Dark Wizard, Class02 the Dark Knight and Class03 the Fairy Elf.
part_note: The torso, 388 triangles. Bound to 146 on Bip01 Spine1, 28 on Bip01 Spine, 26 on Bip01 R UpperArm, 26 on Bip01 L UpperArm, 20 on Bip01 L Clavicle, 14 on Bip01 R Clavicle, 7 on Bip01 R Forearm, 7 on Bip01 L Forearm.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass103.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Fairy Elf's parts name it.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Fairy Elf body, read out of Data/Player/ArmorClass03.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's ArmorClass03 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now fairy elf, then MG"). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.

uv_overrides.why: The green back panel with its belt.
The gold star with its blue stone.

uv_overrides_why: Skin by default, as MuMain's elf torso was all skin: the front piece is painted top, bodice and bare skin in one, too fine for rectangles, and stays skin. The clear blocks of clothing and metal are lifted out. Read off the sheet with the UV layout drawn over it (2026-10-15).
material_note: skin, with the back panel cloth, the straps leather and the brooch and star brass, by uv_overrides.
